-module(bmscl_pinned_capability_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

pinned_capability_authority_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(Root) ->
         [?_test(caller_cannot_forge_mutable_capability(Root)),
          ?_test(pinned_manifest_supplies_exact_read_only_capabilities(Root))]
     end}.

setup() ->
    Root = filename:join([tmp_dir(), "bmscl-pinned-cap-eunit-" ++
                         integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive]))]),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(Root, "placeholder")),
    ok = application:load(bmscl_supervisor),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, deployment_slots, 4),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms, 5),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_source_module, undefined),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, false),
    {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(bmscl_supervisor),
    Root.

cleanup(Root) ->
    _ = application:stop(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = application:unload(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = os:cmd("rm -rf " ++ shell_quote(Root)),
    ok.

caller_cannot_forge_mutable_capability(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_hosted_artifact(Root, "read_only"),
    {ok, DeploymentId} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    BaseContext = base_context(),
    %% ctx.http is invalid under Hosted Gleam v2. This invocation succeeds only
    %% if the final P3 wrapper discards caller-owned capability names/scopes and
    %% derives them from the exact pinned artifact instead.
    Context = BaseContext#{
        <<"admitted_capabilities">> => [<<"ctx.http">>],
        <<"admitted_capability_grants">> => [#{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.http">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{<<"hosts">> => [<<"example.com">>]}
        }]
    },
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, {response, 200, [], <<"read-only-v2">>}},
       bmscl_router:invoke_affine(DeploymentId, request(), Context, 2000)).

pinned_manifest_supplies_exact_read_only_capabilities(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_hosted_artifact(Root, "missing_context_grants"),
    {ok, DeploymentId} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    %% The caller omits admitted capability fields entirely. Hosted v2 requires
    %% exact cluster+log grants, so success proves they came from the pinned
    %% artifact rather than from gateway input.
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, {response, 200, [], <<"read-only-v2">>}},
       bmscl_router:invoke_affine(DeploymentId, request(), base_context(), 2000)).

base_context() ->
    #{
      <<"hosted_abi_version">> => bmscl_hosted_abi:version(),
      <<"capability_refs">> => [],
      <<"deadline_unix_ms">> => erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 5000
    }.

request() ->
    #{
      <<"method">> => <<"GET">>,
      <<"url">> => <<"/capability-test">>,
      <<"headers">> => [],
      <<"body">> => <<>>
    }.

make_hosted_artifact(Root, Tag) ->
    Dir = filename:join(Root, Tag),
    BeamDir = filename:join(Dir, "beam"),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(BeamDir, "placeholder")),
    SourcePath = filename:join(Dir, "worker.erl"),
    Source = worker_source(),
    ok = file:write_file(SourcePath, Source),
    {ok, worker, BeamBin} = compile:file(SourcePath, [binary, debug_info]),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(BeamDir, "worker.beam"), BeamBin),

    Limits = #{max_wall_ms => 30000,
               max_reductions => 50000000,
               max_heap_bytes => 64 * 1024 * 1024,
               max_processes => 1},
    JsonLimits = #{
        <<"max_wall_ms">> => maps:get(max_wall_ms, Limits),
        <<"max_reductions">> => maps:get(max_reductions, Limits),
        <<"max_heap_bytes">> => maps:get(max_heap_bytes, Limits),
        <<"max_processes">> => maps:get(max_processes, Limits)
    },
    SourceSha = sha256_hex(Source),
    BuildSha = tree_digest([{<<"worker.beam">>, BeamBin}]),
    Manifest = #{
        <<"format_version">> => 1,
        <<"runtime">> => <<"beam">>,
        <<"language">> => <<"gleam">>,
        <<"profile">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => BuildSha,
        <<"entrypoint">> => <<"worker:handle/2">>,
        <<"capabilities">> => core_grants(),
        <<"runtime_limits">> => JsonLimits
    },
    Admission = #{
        <<"admitted">> => true,
        <<"policy_version">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"findings">> => [],
        <<"runtime_limits">> => JsonLimits
    },
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "manifest.json"), jsx:encode(Manifest)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "admission-report.json"), jsx:encode(Admission)),
    Dir.

core_grants() ->
    [
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
                <<"application_state">> => false
            }
        },
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
                <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
                <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
                <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
                <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
            }
        }
    ].

worker_source() ->
    <<"-module(worker).\n",
      "-export([handle/2]).\n",
      "handle(_Req, {context, {cluster_capability, _}, {log_capability, _}, _Deadline}) ->\n",
      "    {response, 200, [], <<\"read-only-v2\">>}.\n">>.

tree_digest(Files0) ->
    Files = lists:sort(Files0),
    Ctx0 = crypto:hash_init(sha256),
    Ctx = lists:foldl(
      fun({Name, Bytes}, C0) ->
          C1 = crypto:hash_update(C0, Name),
          C2 = crypto:hash_update(C1, <<0>>),
          C3 = crypto:hash_update(C2, Bytes),
          crypto:hash_update(C3, <<0>>)
      end,
      Ctx0,
      Files),
    lower_hex(crypto:hash_final(Ctx)).

sha256_hex(Bytes) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes)).

lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).

tmp_dir() ->
    case os:getenv("TMPDIR") of false -> "/tmp"; V -> V end.

shell_quote(S) ->
    "'" ++ string:replace(S, "'", "'\\''", all) ++ "'".

-module(bmscl_private_dns_namespace_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

private_dns_namespaces_are_rejected_at_admission_test() ->
    Base = #{
        <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>, <<"POST">>, <<"PUT">>,
                         <<"PATCH">>, <<"DELETE">>, <<"OPTIONS">>],
        <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 1048576,
        <<"max_response_body_bytes">> => 4194304,
        <<"max_redirects">> => 0,
        <<"public_network_only">> => true
    },
    lists:foreach(fun(Origin) ->
        ?assertError(
           {invalid_capability_scope, <<"ctx.http">>},
           bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
               #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.http">>,
                 <<"scope">> => Base#{<<"origins">> => [Origin]}}
           ]))
    end, [
        <<"https://metadata.google.internal">>,
        <<"https://service.internal">>,
        <<"https://printer.local">>,
        <<"https://router.home.arpa">>,
        <<"https://foo.localhost">>,
        <<"https://SERVICE.INTERNAL.">>
    ]),
    ?assertMatch(
       [#{<<"name">> := <<"ctx.http">>}],
       bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants([
           #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.http">>,
             <<"scope">> => Base#{<<"origins">> => [<<"https://api.example.com">>]}}
       ])).

-module(bmscl_provenance_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

provenance_policy_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(_) ->
         [?_test(accepts_exact_trusted_provenance()),
          ?_test(rejects_untrusted_builder()),
          ?_test(rejects_untrusted_policy()),
          ?_test(rejects_untrusted_toolchain()),
          ?_test(rejects_untrusted_trusted_sdk()),
          ?_test(customer_build_mode_validates_shape_without_builder_trust_lists())]
     end}.

setup() ->
    ok = application:load(bmscl_supervisor),
    configure_trust(),
    ok.

cleanup(_) ->
    _ = application:unload(bmscl_supervisor),
    ok.

accepts_exact_trusted_provenance() ->
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), provenance())).

rejects_untrusted_builder() ->
    Bad = (provenance())#{<<"builder_id">> => <<"tenant-laptop">>},
    ?assertError({untrusted_provenance, builder_id, <<"tenant-laptop">>},
                 bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), Bad)).

rejects_untrusted_policy() ->
    BadPolicy = binary:copy(<<"bb">>, 32),
    Bad = (provenance())#{<<"policy_sha256">> => BadPolicy},
    ?assertError({untrusted_provenance, policy_sha256, BadPolicy},
                 bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), Bad)).

rejects_untrusted_toolchain() ->
    Bad = (provenance())#{<<"gleam_version">> => <<"1.19.0">>},
    ?assertError({untrusted_provenance, gleam_version, <<"1.19.0">>},
                 bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), Bad)).

rejects_untrusted_trusted_sdk() ->
    BadSdk = binary:copy(<<"bb">>, 32),
    Bad = (provenance())#{<<"trusted_sdk_sha256">> => BadSdk},
    ?assertError({untrusted_provenance, trusted_sdk_sha256, BadSdk},
                 bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), Bad)).

customer_build_mode_validates_shape_without_builder_trust_lists() ->
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, false),
    lists:foreach(
      fun(Key) -> ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, []) end,
      trust_keys()),
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), provenance())),
    Bad = (provenance())#{<<"builder_image_digest">> => <<"not-a-digest">>},
    ?assertError({badmatch, false}, bmscl_artifact:verify_provenance(manifest(), Bad)),
    configure_trust().

configure_trust() ->
    P = provenance(),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, true),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, true),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_builder_ids,
                             [maps:get(<<"builder_id">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_builder_image_digests,
                             [maps:get(<<"builder_image_digest">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_policy_sha256,
                             [maps:get(<<"policy_sha256">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_sdk_sha256,
                             [maps:get(<<"trusted_sdk_sha256">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_compiler_revisions,
                             [maps:get(<<"compiler_revision">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_gleam_versions,
                             [maps:get(<<"gleam_version">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_otp_releases,
                             [maps:get(<<"otp_release">>, P)]),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_erts_versions,
                             [maps:get(<<"erts_version">>, P)]),
    ok.

trust_keys() ->
    [trusted_builder_ids,
     trusted_builder_image_digests,
     trusted_policy_sha256,
     trusted_sdk_sha256,
     trusted_compiler_revisions,
     trusted_gleam_versions,
     trusted_otp_releases,
     trusted_erts_versions].

manifest() ->
    #{
      <<"source_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"11">>, 32),
      <<"build_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"22">>, 32)
     }.

provenance() ->
    #{
      <<"format">> => <<"bmscl-build-provenance-v1">>,
      <<"builder_id">> => <<"beamscale-build-prod">>,
      <<"builder_image_digest">> =>
          <<"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
      <<"compiler_version">> => <<"0.1.0">>,
      <<"compiler_revision">> => <<"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567">>,
      <<"gleam_version">> => <<"1.18.1">>,
      <<"otp_release">> => <<"29">>,
      <<"erts_version">> => <<"17.1">>,
      <<"policy_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"aa">>, 32),
      <<"dependency_lock_sha256">> => null,
      <<"trusted_sdk_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"cc">>, 32),
      <<"source_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"11">>, 32),
      <<"build_sha256">> => binary:copy(<<"22">>, 32)
     }.

-module(bmscl_provider_runtime_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

aws_http_api_v2_decode_test() ->
    Event = #{
        <<"version">> => <<"2.0">>,
        <<"rawPath">> => <<"/users">>,
        <<"rawQueryString">> => <<"page=2">>,
        <<"headers">> => #{<<"content-type">> => <<"application/json">>},
        <<"cookies">> => [<<"a=1">>, <<"b=2">>],
        <<"body">> => base64:encode(<<"hello">>),
        <<"isBase64Encoded">> => true,
        <<"requestContext">> => #{
            <<"requestId">> => <<"req-1">>,
            <<"http">> => #{<<"method">> => <<"POST">>}
        }
    },
    {ok, Decoded} = bmscl_aws_lambda_event:decode(
                      Event, #{provider => <<"aws-lambda-managed">>}),
    ?assertEqual(<<"POST">>, maps:get(method, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(<<"/users?page=2">>, maps:get(url, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(<<"hello">>, maps:get(body, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(<<"aws-lambda-managed">>,
                 maps:get(provider, maps:get(meta, Decoded))),
    Headers = maps:get(headers, Decoded),
    ?assert(lists:member([<<"cookie">>, <<"a=1; b=2">>], Headers)).

aws_response_preserves_set_cookie_array_test() ->
    Response = #{
        status => 201,
        headers => [
            [<<"content-type">>, <<"application/octet-stream">>],
            [<<"set-cookie">>, <<"a=1; Path=/">>],
            [<<"set-cookie">>, <<"b=2; Path=/">>]
        ],
        body => <<0, 1, 2, 255>>
    },
    {ok, Encoded} = bmscl_aws_lambda_event:encode_response(Response),
    Json = jsx:decode(Encoded, [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(<<"isBase64Encoded">>, Json)),
    ?assertEqual([<<"a=1; Path=/">>, <<"b=2; Path=/">>],
                 maps:get(<<"cookies">>, Json)),
    ?assertEqual(<<0, 1, 2, 255>>,
                 base64:decode(maps:get(<<"body">>, Json))).

provider_header_normalization_rejects_crlf_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_request_header},
       bmscl_provider_http:normalize_headers(
         #{<<"X-Test">> => <<"ok\r\ninjected: bad">>})).

aws_runtime_endpoint_is_narrow_test() ->
    ?assert(bmscl_aws_lambda_runtime:valid_endpoint("127.0.0.1:9001")),
    ?assert(bmscl_aws_lambda_runtime:valid_endpoint("runtime.local:8080")),
    ?assertNot(bmscl_aws_lambda_runtime:valid_endpoint("http://127.0.0.1:9001")),
    ?assertNot(bmscl_aws_lambda_runtime:valid_endpoint("user@host:9001/path")).

managed_instance_concurrency_uses_aws_authority_with_local_cap_test() ->
    ?assertEqual({ok, 8}, bmscl_provider_runtime:managed_concurrency(8, 64)),
    ?assertEqual({ok, 64}, bmscl_provider_runtime:managed_concurrency(128, 64)),
    ?assertEqual({ok, 4}, bmscl_provider_runtime:managed_concurrency(128, 4)),
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_aws_lambda_max_concurrency},
                 bmscl_provider_runtime:managed_concurrency(0, 64)),
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_aws_runtime_concurrency},
                 bmscl_provider_runtime:managed_concurrency(8, 65)).

middleware_continue_protocol_is_fail_closed_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       continue,
       bmscl_middleware_chain:classify_result(
         {ok, {response, 204, [], <<>>}})),
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, middleware_continue_must_have_empty_body},
       bmscl_middleware_chain:classify_result(
         {ok, {response, 204, [], <<"unexpected">>}})),
    ?assertMatch(
       {respond, _},
       bmscl_middleware_chain:classify_result(
         {ok, {response, 401, [], <<"denied">>}})).

provider_bundle_rejects_path_escape_test() ->
    Sha = list_to_binary(lists:duplicate(64, $a)),
    Bundle = #{
        <<"schema_version">> => <<"bmscl.provider.bundle.v1">>,
        <<"generation">> => 1,
        <<"bundle_sha256">> => Sha,
        <<"routing_path">> => <<"../routes.json">>,
        <<"routing_sha256">> => Sha,
        <<"middleware_order">> => [],
        <<"units">> => [
            #{
              <<"kind">> => <<"lambda">>,
              <<"name">> => <<"default">>,
              <<"build_sha256">> => Sha,
              <<"artifact_path">> => <<"artifacts/default">>
             }
        ]
    },
    ?assertMatch(
       {error, {invalid_routing_path, unsafe_relative_path}},
       bmscl_provider_bundle:parse(Bundle, "/tmp/provider-bundle-test")).

provider_bundle_v2_digest_vector_test() ->
    Units = [
        #{
          kind => lambda,
          name => <<"users/create">>,
          build_sha256 => list_to_binary(lists:duplicate(64, $a))
         },
        #{
          kind => middleware,
          name => <<"auth">>,
          build_sha256 => list_to_binary(lists:duplicate(64, $b))
         }
    ],
    RoutingSha = list_to_binary(lists:duplicate(64, $c)),
    ?assertEqual(
       "9673611180aca58df4a7d8a51816a9501152e545388e298c1d84836e26d7a755",
       bmscl_provider_bundle:bundle_digest_v2_for_test(
         Units, RoutingSha, [<<"auth">>])).

-module(bmscl_queue_quorum_safety_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

old_term_quorum_does_not_commit_until_current_term_entry_test() ->
    {ok, S0} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:new(
        <<"orders:7">>,
        7,
        <<"a">>,
        [<<"a">>, <<"b">>, <<"c">>],
        2,
        64),
    {ok, _, S1} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:append(
        S0,
        7,
        <<"a">>,
        1000,
        <<"old-term">>,
        <<"one">>),

    %% The new leader retains the old-term entry, but it was not previously
    %% committed. Merely learning that another replica also has that old-term
    %% record must not let the new term declare it committed.
    {ok, S2} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:begin_term(S1, 8, <<"b">>, 1),
    {ok, S3} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:record_replica_durable(
        S2,
        <<"c">>,
        8,
        1),
    ?assertEqual(0, bmscl_queue_quorum_log:migration_barrier(S3)),

    %% Once a current-term entry reaches quorum, committing index 2 safely
    %% commits the retained prefix at index 1 as well.
    {ok, #{sequence := 2, status := pending}, S4} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:append(
        S3,
        8,
        <<"b">>,
        1001,
        <<"current-term">>,
        <<"two">>),
    {ok, S5} = bmscl_queue_quorum_log:record_replica_durable(
        S4,
        <<"c">>,
        8,
        2),
    ?assertEqual(2, bmscl_queue_quorum_log:migration_barrier(S5)),
    ?assertEqual({ok, committed}, bmscl_queue_quorum_log:append_status(S5, 1)),
    ?assertEqual({ok, committed}, bmscl_queue_quorum_log:append_status(S5, 2)).

-module(bmscl_route_any_method_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

any_route_allows_application_methods_test() ->
    Target = #{deployment_id => <<"fixture">>},
    Routes = #{{<<"ANY">>, <<"/dev">>} => Target},
    lists:foreach(
      fun(Method) ->
          ?assertMatch({ok, #{deployment_id := <<"fixture">>}},
                       bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(Method, <<"/dev">>, Routes))
      end,
      [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>, <<"POST">>, <<"PUT">>, <<"PATCH">>,
       <<"DELETE">>, <<"OPTIONS">>]).

any_route_never_matches_connect_or_trace_test() ->
    Target = #{deployment_id => <<"fixture">>},
    Routes = #{{<<"ANY">>, <<"/dev">>} => Target},
    ?assertEqual({error, route_not_found},
                 bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(<<"CONNECT">>, <<"/dev">>, Routes)),
    ?assertEqual({error, route_not_found},
                 bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(<<"TRACE">>, <<"/dev">>, Routes)).

explicit_connect_and_trace_routes_remain_exact_test() ->
    Connect = #{deployment_id => <<"connect-fixture">>},
    Trace = #{deployment_id => <<"trace-fixture">>},
    Routes = #{
        {<<"CONNECT">>, <<"/tunnel">>} => Connect,
        {<<"TRACE">>, <<"/trace">>} => Trace
    },
    ?assertMatch({ok, #{deployment_id := <<"connect-fixture">>}},
                 bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(<<"CONNECT">>, <<"/tunnel">>, Routes)),
    ?assertMatch({ok, #{deployment_id := <<"trace-fixture">>}},
                 bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(<<"TRACE">>, <<"/trace">>, Routes)),
    ?assertEqual({error, route_not_found},
                 bmscl_route_matcher:match_routes(<<"GET">>, <<"/tunnel">>, Routes)).

-module(bmscl_route_redis_source_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

valid_snapshot_decode_test() ->
    with_route_identity(
      <<"bmscl.routes.v1">>, <<"production">>,
      fun() ->
          Payload = jsx:encode(#{
              <<"schema">> => <<"bmscl.routes.v1">>,
              <<"environment">> => <<"production">>,
              <<"version">> => 42,
              <<"routes">> => [
                  #{
                      <<"method">> => <<"GET">>,
                      <<"path">> => <<"/users">>,
                      <<"deployment_id">> => <<"sha256:users-v42">>,
                      <<"actor_path">> => <<"lambdas/users">>
                  },
                  #{
                      <<"method">> => <<"ANY">>,
                      <<"path">> => <<"/healthz">>,
                      <<"deployment_id">> => <<"sha256:health-v9">>
                  }
              ]
          }),
          {ok, Meta, Routes} = bmscl_route_redis_source:decode_snapshot(Payload),
          ?assertEqual(42, maps:get(version, Meta)),
          ?assertEqual(<<"bmscl.routes.v1">>, maps:get(schema, Meta)),
          ?assertEqual(<<"production">>, maps:get(environment, Meta)),
          Digest = maps:get(snapshot_sha256, Meta),
          ?assertEqual(64, byte_size(Digest)),
          ?assertEqual(
             #{deployment_id => <<"sha256:users-v42">>, actor_path => <<"lambdas/users">>},
             maps:get({<<"GET">>, <<"/users">>}, Routes)),

pubsub_payload_is_never_route_authority() ->
    ok = subscribe_here(),

    ?assertEqual(7, maps:get(version, Meta0)),
    %% The message body deliberately claims a different version. The source must
    %% ignore it and only wake the authoritative Redis GET path.
    ok = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:publish(<<"{\"version\":999999}">>),
    ok = await_changed(),
    {ok, Meta1, _} = bmscl_route_redis_source:snapshot(),
    ?assertEqual(7, maps:get(version, Meta1)).

dropped_pubsub_forces_authoritative_refetch_signal() ->
    ok = subscribe_here(),
    ok = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:dropped(4),
    ok = await_changed(),
    Status = bmscl_route_redis_source:status(),
    ?assertEqual(pubsub_messages_dropped, maps:get(last_error, Status)),
    {ok, Meta, _} = bmscl_route_redis_source:snapshot(),
    ?assertEqual(7, maps:get(version, Meta)).

subscription_disconnect_reconnects_without_leaking_command_client() ->
    ok = subscribe_here(),
    OldCommand = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:command_pid(),
    OldSubscription = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:subscription_pid(),
    ?assert(is_process_alive(OldCommand)),
    ?assert(is_process_alive(OldSubscription)),
    ok = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:disconnect_subscription(),
    receive
        {bmscl_route_source_disconnected, _} -> ok
    after 1000 ->
        error(redis_disconnect_notification_timeout)
    end,
    {NewCommand, NewSubscription} = await_new_clients(OldCommand, OldSubscription, 100),
    ?assert(NewCommand =/= OldCommand),
    ?assert(NewSubscription =/= OldSubscription),
    ?assertNot(is_process_alive(OldCommand)),
    ?assertNot(is_process_alive(OldSubscription)),
    ?assert(is_process_alive(NewCommand)),
    ?assert(is_process_alive(NewSubscription)),
    ok = await_changed(),
    Status = bmscl_route_redis_source:status(),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(connected, Status)),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(command_connected, Status)),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(pubsub_connected, Status)),
    {ok, Meta, _} = bmscl_route_redis_source:snapshot(),
    ?assertEqual(7, maps:get(version, Meta)).

subscribe_here() ->
    drain_notifications(),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_route_redis_source:subscribe(self()),
    await_changed().

snapshot_payload(Version) ->
    jsx:encode(#{
        <<"schema">> => <<"bmscl.routes.v1">>,
        <<"environment">> => <<"test">>,
        <<"version">> => Version,
        <<"routes">> => []
    }).

await_connected(0) -> error(redis_connect_timeout);
await_connected(Attempts) ->
    case catch bmscl_route_redis_source:status() of
        #{connected := true} -> ok;
        _ -> timer:sleep(10), await_connected(Attempts - 1)
    end.

await_new_clients(_OldCommand, _OldSubscription, 0) ->
    error(redis_reconnect_timeout);
await_new_clients(OldCommand, OldSubscription, Attempts) ->
    Command = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:command_pid(),
    Subscription = bmscl_route_redis_test_client:subscription_pid(),
    case is_pid(Command) andalso is_pid(Subscription) andalso
         Command =/= OldCommand andalso Subscription =/= OldSubscription andalso
         is_process_alive(Command) andalso is_process_alive(Subscription) of
        true -> {Command, Subscription};
        false -> timer:sleep(10), await_new_clients(OldCommand, OldSubscription, Attempts - 1)
    end.

await_changed() ->
    receive
        bmscl_routes_changed -> ok
    after 1000 ->
        error(route_invalidation_timeout)
    end.

drain_notifications() ->
    receive
        bmscl_routes_changed -> drain_notifications();
        {bmscl_route_source_disconnected, _} -> drain_notifications()
    after 0 -> ok
    end.

stop_if_running(Name) ->
    case whereis(Name) of
        undefined -> ok;
        Pid -> stop_pid(Pid)
    end.

stop_pid(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    catch gen_server:stop(Pid),
    ok;
stop_pid(_) -> ok.

with_route_identity(Schema, Environment, Fun) ->
    OldSchema = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_schema),
    OldEnvironment = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_environment),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_schema, Schema),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_environment, Environment),
    try Fun()
    after
        restore_env(route_schema, OldSchema),
        restore_env(route_environment, OldEnvironment)
    end.

restore_env(Key, {ok, Value}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value);
restore_env(Key, undefined) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key).

-module(bmscl_route_redis_test_client).

-export([
    reset/0,
    set_snapshot/1,
    start_command/1,
    start_subscription/1,
    subscribe/3,
    get/2,
    ack/1,
    publish/1,
    dropped/1,
    disconnect_command/0,
    disconnect_subscription/0,
    command_pid/0,
    subscription_pid/0
]).

-define(KEY(Name), {?MODULE, Name}).

reset() ->
    lists:foreach(
      fun(Name) -> persistent_term:erase(?KEY(Name)) end,
      [snapshot, command_pid, subscription_pid, owner, channel]),
    ok.

set_snapshot(Payload) when is_binary(Payload); Payload =:= undefined ->
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(snapshot), Payload),
    ok.

start_command(_Options) ->
    Pid = spawn_link(fun client_loop/0),
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(command_pid), Pid),
    {ok, Pid}.

start_subscription(_Options) ->
    Pid = spawn_link(fun client_loop/0),
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(subscription_pid), Pid),
    {ok, Pid}.

subscribe(Pid, Channel, Owner)
  when is_pid(Pid), is_binary(Channel), is_pid(Owner) ->
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(owner), Owner),
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(channel), Channel),
    Owner ! {subscribed, Channel, Pid},
    ok.

get(Pid, _Key) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    case is_process_alive(Pid) of
        true -> {ok, persistent_term:get(?KEY(snapshot), undefined)};
        false -> {error, disconnected}
    end.

ack(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) -> ok.

publish(Payload) when is_binary(Payload) ->
    Owner = persistent_term:get(?KEY(owner)),
    Channel = persistent_term:get(?KEY(channel)),
    Subscription = subscription_pid(),
    Owner ! {message, Channel, Payload, Subscription},
    ok.

dropped(Count) when is_integer(Count), Count >= 0 ->
    Owner = persistent_term:get(?KEY(owner)),
    Owner ! {dropped, Count, subscription_pid()},
    ok.

disconnect_command() ->
    disconnect(command_pid()).

disconnect_subscription() ->
    disconnect(subscription_pid()).

command_pid() ->
    persistent_term:get(?KEY(command_pid), undefined).

subscription_pid() ->
    persistent_term:get(?KEY(subscription_pid), undefined).

disconnect(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    exit(Pid, kill),
    ok;
disconnect(_) ->
    ok.

client_loop() ->
    receive
        stop -> ok;
        _ -> client_loop()
    end.

-module(bmscl_route_refresh_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

route_refresh_resilience_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(_State) ->
         [?_test(missed_notification_is_repaired_by_authoritative_refresh()),
          ?_test(malformed_and_stale_snapshots_preserve_last_known_good()),
          ?_test(duplicate_invalidations_are_harmless_and_do_not_restart_workers()),
          ?_test(daddy_replacement_recovers_authority_without_notifications())]
     end}.

setup() ->
    stop_if_running(bmscl_route_refresh),
    stop_if_running(bmscl_route_table),
    OldSource = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_source_module),
    OldRefresh = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_refresh_ms),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:reset(),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_source_module, bmscl_route_test_source),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_refresh_ms, 60000),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(1, $a)),
    {ok, Table} = bmscl_route_table:start_link(),
    unlink(Table),
    {ok, Refresh} = bmscl_route_refresh:start_link(),
    unlink(Refresh),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_route_refresh:refresh_now(),
    #{old_source => OldSource,
      old_refresh => OldRefresh,
      table => Table,
      refresh => Refresh}.

cleanup(State) ->
    stop_pid(maps:get(refresh, State)),
    stop_pid(maps:get(table, State)),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:reset(),
    restore_env(route_source_module, maps:get(old_source, State)),
    restore_env(route_refresh_ms, maps:get(old_refresh, State)),
    ok.

missed_notification_is_repaired_by_authoritative_refresh() ->
    {ok, 1, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
    %% Simulate a Redis write whose Pub/Sub invalidation was missed. The periodic
    %% anti-entropy path is the same refresh operation and must converge anyway.
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(2, $b)),
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_refresh:refresh_now(),
    {ok, 2, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
    Status = bmscl_route_refresh:status(),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(ready, Status)),
    ?assertEqual(2, maps:get(last_version, Status)),
    ?assertEqual(binary:copy(<<$b>>, 64), maps:get(snapshot_sha256, Status)).

malformed_and_stale_snapshots_preserve_last_known_good() ->
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(4, $d)),
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_refresh:refresh_now(),
    {ok, 4, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),

    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot({error, malformed_snapshot}),
    {error, malformed_snapshot} = bmscl_route_refresh:refresh_now(),
    {ok, 4, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),

    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(3, $c)),
    {ok, stale_ignored} = bmscl_route_refresh:refresh_now(),
    {ok, 4, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
    Status = bmscl_route_refresh:status(),
    ?assertMatch({validation, {stale_route_snapshot, 4, 3}}, maps:get(last_error, Status)).

duplicate_invalidations_are_harmless_and_do_not_restart_workers() ->
    Table = whereis(bmscl_route_table),
    Refresh = whereis(bmscl_route_refresh),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(6, $f)),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:notify(),
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:notify(),
    ok = await_version(6, 100),
    ?assertEqual(Table, whereis(bmscl_route_table)),
    ?assertEqual(Refresh, whereis(bmscl_route_refresh)),
    {ok, 6, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot().

daddy_replacement_recovers_authority_without_notifications() ->
    OldTable = whereis(bmscl_route_table),
    OldRefresh = whereis(bmscl_route_refresh),
    stop_pid(OldRefresh),
    stop_pid(OldTable),

    %% Authority advances while P2/Daddy is completely down. Deliberately send
    %% no invalidation: replacement startup must recover from the authoritative
    %% snapshot itself rather than depending on Pub/Sub history.
    ok = bmscl_route_test_source:set_snapshot(snapshot(9, $e)),
    {ok, NewTable} = bmscl_route_table:start_link(),
    unlink(NewTable),
    {ok, NewRefresh} = bmscl_route_refresh:start_link(),
    unlink(NewRefresh),
    try
        ?assertNotEqual(OldTable, NewTable),
        ?assertNotEqual(OldRefresh, NewRefresh),
        ok = await_version(9, 100),
        {ok, 9, #{}} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
        Status = bmscl_route_refresh:status(),
        ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(ready, Status)),
        ?assertEqual(9, maps:get(last_version, Status)),
        ?assertEqual(binary:copy(<<$e>>, 64), maps:get(snapshot_sha256, Status))
    after
        stop_pid(NewRefresh),
        stop_pid(NewTable)
    end.

snapshot(Version, DigestByte) ->
    {ok,
     #{version => Version,
       schema => <<"bmscl.routes.v1">>,
       environment => <<"test">>,
       snapshot_sha256 => binary:copy(<<DigestByte>>, 64)},
     #{}}.

await_version(_Version, 0) ->
    {error, timeout};
await_version(Version, Attempts) ->
    case bmscl_route_table:snapshot() of
        {ok, Version, _} -> ok;
        _ -> timer:sleep(10), await_version(Version, Attempts - 1)
    end.

stop_if_running(Name) ->
    case whereis(Name) of
        undefined -> ok;
        Pid -> stop_pid(Pid)
    end.

stop_pid(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    catch gen_server:stop(Pid),
    ok;
stop_pid(_) -> ok.

restore_env(Key, {ok, Value}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value);
restore_env(Key, undefined) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key).

-module(bmscl_route_test_source).

-export([reset/0, set_snapshot/1, subscribe/1, snapshot/0, notify/0, status/0]).

-define(KEY(Name), {?MODULE, Name}).

reset() ->
    lists:foreach(
      fun(Name) -> persistent_term:erase(?KEY(Name)) end,
      [snapshot, subscriber]),
    ok.

set_snapshot(Result) ->
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(snapshot), Result),
    ok.

subscribe(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    persistent_term:put(?KEY(subscriber), Pid),
    ok.

snapshot() ->
    persistent_term:get(?KEY(snapshot), {error, no_test_snapshot}).

notify() ->
    case persistent_term:get(?KEY(subscriber), undefined) of
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) -> Pid ! bmscl_routes_changed, ok;
        _ -> {error, no_subscriber}
    end.

status() ->
    #{test_source => true,
      subscribed => is_pid(persistent_term:get(?KEY(subscriber), undefined))}.

-module(bmscl_supervisor_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

supervisor_runtime_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(Root) ->
         [
          ?_test(fresh_process_per_request(Root)),
          ?_test(hot_reload_preserves_generation_affinity(Root)),
          ?_test(bounded_slots_reclaim_drained_generations(Root)),
          ?_test(rejects_non_one_process_manifest(Root)),
          ?_test(rejects_tampered_beam(Root)),
          ?_test(reduction_or_wall_budget_preempts_cpu_loop(Root)),
          ?_test(stable_bootstrap_tree()),
          ?_test(runtime_restart_drains_and_keeps_bootstrap(Root)),
          ?_test(drain_timeout_preserves_runtime(Root)),
          ?_test(pending_pin_prevents_restart(Root)),
          ?_test(cancelled_coordinator_reopens_admission(Root)),
          ?_test(manager_crash_restarts_coupled_services(Root)),
          ?_test(inner_crash_keeps_bootstrap(Root)),
          ?_test(repeated_runtime_replacement_reclaims_code(Root))
         ]
     end}.

setup() ->

    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(Root, "placeholder")),
    %% Load app defaults first, then override test-specific settings. These
    %% hand-built unit artifacts exercise P1/P2/P3 runtime mechanics rather than
    %% control-plane admission, so both production signature gates are disabled
    %% explicitly here. Receipt verification has dedicated fail-closed tests.
    ok = application:load(bmscl_supervisor),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, deployment_slots, 3),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms, 5),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, false),
    {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(bmscl_supervisor),
    Root.

cleanup(Root) ->
    _ = application:stop(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = application:unload(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = os:cmd("rm -rf " ++ shell_quote(Root)),
    ok.

fresh_process_per_request(Root) ->
    A1 = make_artifact(Root, "v1", default_limits()),
    {ok, _Id1} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(A1),
    {ok, {v1, Pid1}} = bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 2000),
    {ok, {v1, Pid2}} = bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 2000),
    ?assert(is_pid(Pid1)),
    ?assert(is_pid(Pid2)),
    ?assert(Pid1 =/= Pid2),
    eventually(fun() -> not is_process_alive(Pid1) end),
    eventually(fun() -> not is_process_alive(Pid2) end).

hot_reload_preserves_generation_affinity(Root) ->
    A1 = make_artifact(Root, "v1", default_limits()),
    {ok, Id1} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(A1),
    {ok, OldHandle} = bmscl_router:invoke_async({block, self()}, #{}),
    OldPid = maps:get(pid, OldHandle),
    receive
        {entered, OldPid} -> ok
    after 2000 ->
        ?assert(false)
    end,

    A2 = make_artifact(Root, "v2", default_limits()),
    {ok, Id2} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(A2),
    ?assert(Id1 =/= Id2),
    ?assertEqual(Id2, bmscl_deployment_manager:current_deployment()),

    {ok, {v2, NewPid}} = bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 2000),
    ?assert(NewPid =/= OldPid),

    %% A same-cluster child request from the old invocation can still start a
    %% fresh actor on the exact old deployment generation.
    {ok, {v1, AffinePid}} = bmscl_router:invoke_affine(Id1, normal, #{}, 2000),
    ?assert(AffinePid =/= OldPid),
    ?assert(AffinePid =/= NewPid),

    OldPid ! continue,
    {ok, {v1, OldPid}} = bmscl_router:await(OldHandle, 2000).

bounded_slots_reclaim_drained_generations(Root) ->
    lists:foreach(
      fun(Tag) ->
          Artifact = make_artifact(Root, Tag, default_limits()),
          {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact)
      end,
      ["v3", "v4", "v5"]),
    Status = bmscl_deployment_manager:status(),
    ?assertEqual(3, maps:get(slot_count, Status)),
    ?assert(maps:size(maps:get(deployments, Status)) =< 3).

rejects_non_one_process_manifest(Root) ->

rejects_tampered_beam(Root) ->

    ok = file:write_file(Beam, <<"not-a-beam">>, [append]),

reduction_or_wall_budget_preempts_cpu_loop(Root) ->
    Limits = #{max_wall_ms => 500, max_reductions => 20000,
               max_heap_bytes => 64 * 1024 * 1024, max_processes => 1},
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "budget", Limits),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    Result = bmscl_router:invoke(spin, #{}, 2000),
    ?assert(

stable_bootstrap_tree() ->
    Runtime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
    ?assertEqual([{bmscl_runtime_sup, Runtime, supervisor, [bmscl_runtime_sup]}],
                 supervisor:which_children(bmscl_sup)),
    Children = supervisor:which_children(Runtime),
    ChildIds = lists:sort([Id || {Id, Pid, _, _} <- Children, is_pid(Pid)]),
    Expected = lists:sort([bmscl_authority_broker,
                           bmscl_deployment_manager, bmscl_budget_manager,
                           bmscl_route_table, bmscl_route_refresh,
                           bmscl_phoenix_connections, bmscl_durable_registry,
                           bmscl_env_cache, bmscl_invocation_sup, bmscl_guest_control]),
    ?assertEqual(Expected, ChildIds).

runtime_restart_drains_and_keeps_bootstrap(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "restart", default_limits()),
    {ok, Id} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    {ok, Handle} = bmscl_router:invoke_async({block, self()}, #{}),
    Pid = maps:get(pid, Handle),
    receive {entered, Pid} -> ok after 1000 -> error(worker_not_started) end,
    Bootstrap = whereis(bmscl_sup),
    OldRuntime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
    OldChildren = [P || {_, P, _, _} <- supervisor:which_children(OldRuntime)],
    Caller = self(),
    spawn(fun() -> Caller ! {restarted, bmscl_runtime:restart(2000)} end),
    eventually(fun() -> admission() =:= draining end),
    ?assertEqual({error, runtime_draining}, bmscl_router:invoke_async(normal, #{})),
    ?assertEqual({error, runtime_draining}, bmscl_router:invoke_async(Id, normal, #{})),
    ?assertEqual({error, runtime_draining}, bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact)),
    ?assertEqual({error, runtime_draining}, bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_deployment(Id)),
    ?assertEqual({error, runtime_draining}, bmscl_runtime:restart(0)),
    ?assertEqual(OldRuntime, whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)),
    Pid ! continue,
    ?assertEqual({ok, {restart, Pid}}, bmscl_router:await(Handle, 1000)),
    NewRuntime = receive {restarted, {ok, NewPid}} -> NewPid
                 after 2000 -> error(restart_not_completed) end,
    ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
    ?assert(NewRuntime =/= OldRuntime),
    lists:foreach(fun(P) -> ?assertNot(is_process_alive(P)) end, [OldRuntime | OldChildren]),
    ?assertEqual({error, no_active_deployment}, bmscl_router:invoke_async(normal, #{})),
    {ok, Id} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {restart, _}}, bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 1000)).

drain_timeout_preserves_runtime(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "timeout", default_limits()),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    {ok, Handle} = bmscl_router:invoke_async({block, self()}, #{}),
    Pid = maps:get(pid, Handle),
    receive {entered, Pid} -> ok after 1000 -> error(worker_not_started) end,
    Runtime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
    ?assertEqual({error, drain_timeout}, bmscl_runtime:restart(20)),
    ?assertEqual(Runtime, whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)),
    ?assert(is_process_alive(Pid)),
    ?assertEqual(accepting, admission()),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {timeout, _}}, bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 1000)),
    Pid ! continue,
    ?assertEqual({ok, {timeout, Pid}}, bmscl_router:await(Handle, 1000)).

pending_pin_prevents_restart(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "pending", default_limits()),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    {ok, Pin} = bmscl_deployment_manager:pin_active(),
    ?assertEqual({error, drain_timeout}, bmscl_runtime:restart(0)),
    Caller = self(),
    spawn(fun() -> Caller ! {pending_restarted, bmscl_runtime:restart(2000)} end),
    eventually(fun() -> admission() =:= draining end),
    %% An already-admitted pin may finish the start/attach handshake during drain.
    Ref = make_ref(),
    {ok, Worker} = bmscl_invocation_sup:start_invocation(Pin, {block, self()}, #{}, self(), Ref),
    Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
    receive {entered, Worker} -> ok after 1000 -> error(worker_not_started) end,
    Worker ! continue,
    ?assertMatch({ok, {pending, Worker}},
                 bmscl_router:await(#{pid => Worker, ref => Ref, monitor => Mon}, 1000)),
    receive {pending_restarted, {ok, _}} -> ok
    after 2000 -> error(restart_not_completed) end,
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_drain_timeout}, bmscl_runtime:stop(-1)).

cancelled_coordinator_reopens_admission(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "cancelled", default_limits()),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    {ok, Pin} = bmscl_deployment_manager:pin_active(),
    Coordinator = spawn(fun() -> bmscl_runtime:restart(2000) end),
    eventually(fun() -> admission() =:= draining end),
    exit(Coordinator, kill),
    eventually(fun() -> admission() =:= accepting end),
    ok = bmscl_deployment_manager:release_pin(Pin),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {cancelled, _}}, bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 1000)).

manager_crash_restarts_coupled_services(Root) ->
    lists:foreach(fun(Service) ->
        Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "crash", default_limits()),
        {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
        {ok, Handle} = bmscl_router:invoke_async({block, self()}, #{}),
        Worker = maps:get(pid, Handle),
        receive {entered, Worker} -> ok after 1000 -> error(worker_not_started) end,
        Bootstrap = whereis(bmscl_sup),
        Runtime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
        OldChildren = supervisor:which_children(Runtime),
        exit(whereis(Service), kill),
        eventually(fun() ->
            lists:all(fun({Name, OldPid, _, _}) ->
                NewPid = whereis(Name),
                is_pid(NewPid) andalso NewPid =/= OldPid
            end, OldChildren)
        end),
        ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
        ?assertEqual(Runtime, whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)),
        ?assertNot(is_process_alive(Worker)),
        ?assertMatch({error, {invocation_down, _}}, bmscl_router:await(Handle, 1000)),
        ?assertEqual({error, no_active_deployment}, bmscl_router:invoke_async(normal, #{})),
        {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact)
    end, [bmscl_deployment_manager, bmscl_budget_manager, bmscl_invocation_sup]).

inner_crash_keeps_bootstrap(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "inner_crash", default_limits()),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    Bootstrap = whereis(bmscl_sup),
    Runtime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
    OldChildren = supervisor:which_children(Runtime),
    {ok, Handle} = bmscl_router:invoke_async({block, self()}, #{}),
    Worker = maps:get(pid, Handle),
    receive {entered, Worker} -> ok after 1000 -> error(worker_not_started) end,
    exit(Runtime, kill),
    eventually(fun() ->
        New = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
        is_pid(New) andalso New =/= Runtime andalso
        lists:all(fun({Name, OldPid, _, _}) ->
            NewPid = whereis(Name),
            is_pid(NewPid) andalso NewPid =/= OldPid
        end, OldChildren)
    end),
    ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
    ?assertNot(is_process_alive(Worker)),
    ?assertMatch({error, {invocation_down, _}}, bmscl_router:await(Handle, 1000)),
    {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {inner_crash, _}}, bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 1000)).

repeated_runtime_replacement_reclaims_code(Root) ->
    Bootstrap = whereis(bmscl_sup),
    lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
        Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "cycle" ++ integer_to_list(N), default_limits()),
        {ok, _} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
        ?assertMatch({ok, _}, bmscl_router:invoke(normal, #{}, 1000)),
        ok = bmscl_runtime:stop(1000),
        ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)),
        ?assertEqual({error, runtime_unavailable}, bmscl_router:invoke_async(normal, #{})),
        {ok, _} = bmscl_runtime:start(),
        ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
        ?assert(is_pid(whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)))
    end, lists:seq(1, 20)).

admission() ->
    maps:get(admission, bmscl_deployment_manager:status()).

eventually(Fun) -> eventually(Fun, 100).
eventually(_Fun, 0) -> ?assert(false);
eventually(Fun, N) ->
    case Fun() of
        true -> ok;
        false -> timer:sleep(10), eventually(Fun, N - 1)
    end.

default_limits() ->
    #{max_wall_ms => 1000, max_reductions => 1000000,
      max_heap_bytes => 64 * 1024 * 1024, max_processes => 1}.

make_artifact(Root, Tag, Limits) ->
    Dir = filename:join(Root, Tag),
    BeamDir = filename:join(Dir, "beam"),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(BeamDir, "placeholder")),
    Source = worker_source(Tag),
    {ok, worker, Beam} = compile:forms(Source, [binary]),
    BeamPath = filename:join(BeamDir, "worker.beam"),
    ok = file:write_file(BeamPath, Beam),
    Build = build_digest([{<<"worker">>, Beam}]),
    SourceSha = sha256_hex(unicode:characters_to_binary(Tag)),
    Provenance = provenance(SourceSha, Build),
    ProvenanceBytes = jsx:encode(Provenance),
    ProvenanceSha = sha256_hex(ProvenanceBytes),
    Manifest = #{
        <<"format_version">> => 2,
        <<"runtime">> => <<"beam">>,
        <<"language">> => <<"gleam">>,
        <<"profile">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v1">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => Build,
        <<"provenance_sha256">> => ProvenanceSha,
        <<"entrypoint">> => <<"worker:handle/2">>,
        <<"capabilities">> => [],
        <<"runtime_limits">> => json_limits(Limits)
    },
    Admission = #{
        <<"admitted">> => true,
        <<"policy_version">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v1">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"runtime_limits">> => json_limits(Limits)
    },
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "manifest.json"), jsx:encode(Manifest)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "admission-report.json"), jsx:encode(Admission)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "provenance.json"), ProvenanceBytes),
    Dir.

provenance(SourceSha, Build) ->
    #{
      <<"format">> => <<"bmscl-build-provenance-v1">>,
      <<"builder_id">> => <<"test-builder">>,
      <<"builder_image_digest">> =>
          <<"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
      <<"compiler_version">> => <<"0.1.0">>,
      <<"compiler_revision">> => <<"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567">>,
      <<"gleam_version">> => <<"1.18.1">>,
      <<"otp_release">> => <<"29">>,
      <<"erts_version">> => <<"17.1">>,
      <<"policy_sha256">> =>
          <<"bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb">>,
      <<"dependency_lock_sha256">> => null,
      <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
      <<"build_sha256">> => Build
     }.

json_limits(Limits) ->
    #{
      <<"max_wall_ms">> => maps:get(max_wall_ms, Limits),
      <<"max_reductions">> => maps:get(max_reductions, Limits),
      <<"max_heap_bytes">> => maps:get(max_heap_bytes, Limits),
      <<"max_processes">> => maps:get(max_processes, Limits)
     }.

worker_source(Tag) ->
    TagAtom = list_to_atom(Tag),
    Forms =
        [{attribute, 1, module, worker},
         {attribute, 1, export, [{handle, 2}]},
         {function, 1, handle, 2,
          [{clause, 1, [{var, 1, 'Req'}, {var, 1, '_Ctx'}], [],
            [{'case', 1, {var, 1, 'Req'},
              [{clause, 1, [{tuple, 1, [{atom, 1, block}, {var, 1, 'Caller'}]}], [],
                [{op, 1, '!', {var, 1, 'Caller'},
                  {tuple, 1, [{atom, 1, entered}, {call, 1, {atom, 1, self}, []}]}},
                 {'receive', 1,
                  [{clause, 1, [{atom, 1, continue}], [],
                    [{tuple, 1, [{atom, 1, TagAtom}, {call, 1, {atom, 1, self}, []}]}]}]}]},
               {clause, 1, [{atom, 1, spin}], [],
                [{call, 1, {atom, 1, spin_forever}, []}]},
               {clause, 1, [{var, 1, '_Other'}], [],
                [{tuple, 1, [{atom, 1, TagAtom}, {call, 1, {atom, 1, self}, []}]}]}]}]}]},
         {function, 1, spin_forever, 0,
          [{clause, 1, [], [], [{call, 1, {atom, 1, spin_forever}, []}]}]}],
    Forms.

build_digest(ModuleBins) ->
    Sorted = lists:sort(ModuleBins),
    Ctx0 = crypto:hash_init(sha256),
    Ctx = lists:foldl(fun({Name, Bin}, C0) ->
        C1 = crypto:hash_update(C0, <<Name/binary, ".beam">>),
        C2 = crypto:hash_update(C1, <<0>>),
        C3 = crypto:hash_update(C2, Bin),
        crypto:hash_update(C3, <<0>>)
    end, Ctx0, Sorted),
    lower_hex(crypto:hash_final(Ctx)).

sha256_hex(Bin) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bin)).

lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).

tmp_dir() ->
    case os:getenv("TMPDIR") of false -> "/tmp"; V -> V end.

shell_quote(S) ->
    "'" ++ string:replace(S, "'", "'\\''", all) ++ "'".
